_note: Media manifest. Same constraint as the data manifest: no build step and no directory listing, so every file is enumerated. preloadGroup controls what is fetched before the first frame ('boot'), what is fetched on chapter entry ('chapter1'/'chapter2'), and what streams on demand ('lazy'). Empty arrays are correct — the visual direction is not set yet (README 'Next' item 4).

palettes._note: Chapter palettes live in src/ui/styles/tokens.css as CSS custom properties, switched by a data-chapter attribute on the root element — NOT in JSON. Colour belongs in the stylesheet; this entry exists only to say so, so nobody adds a second source of truth here.

_plannedGroups._note: The shape entries will take, recorded now so the first real asset does not have to invent it: { id, path, preloadGroup, chapter }. Ids are kebab-case and stable, like every other id in the project.
